solver_continuity_equation: Constant-reference-density incompressible Boussinesq continuity: div(U)=0 in the continuum; discrete pressure equation enforces D(phi)=0 for corrected face volume flux. rhok=1-beta*(T-TRef) is a buoyancy factor, not a transported continuity density.
phi_meaning: Signed oriented face volume flux, m^3/s; initially fvc::flux(U), then independently corrected by phi=phiHbyA-p_rghEqn.flux(). Constant rho0*phi is the corresponding discrete mass flux.
pressure_velocity_relation: U=HbyA+rAU*fvc::reconstruct((phig-p_rghEqn.flux())/rAUf), after pressure relaxation. Reinterpolating the updated collocated cell U does not reproduce the corrected face phi exactly.
epsilon_phi_definition: L/Up times volume mean of abs(sum oriented saved face phi/cell volume). Internal owner adds phi, neighbour subtracts phi; physical boundary fluxes included; empty faces contribute zero. Uniform cells make arithmetic and volume means identical.
epsilon_v_definition: L/Up times mean abs(div(I_central(U))). Interior face normal velocities are arithmetic cell averages; four no-slip boundary face values are zero; Cartesian differences divide by hx,hy. Up=max cell |U| in m/s.
epsilon_m_definition: epsilon_m=epsilon_v for this reconstructed-U operator, since div(rho0 U)=rho0 div(U) for constant rho0. This equality is not a measurement of the independently corrected solver mass flux rho0*phi.

current_formal_criterion.epsilon_phi_role: separate solver-flux diagnostic; not substituted for epsilon_m

baseline_12000_result.mass_relation: rho0 is constant, so normalized mass- and volume-divergence metrics are identical; solver phi is volume flux

continuity.mass_relation: rho0 is constant, so normalized mass- and volume-divergence metrics are identical; solver phi is volume flux

interpretation: The large gap primarily reflects different discrete operators: pressure-corrected saved face flux versus central reconstruction of cell U. A tiny epsilon_phi is evidence of discrete solver continuity; the nonzero reconstructed divergence does not by itself establish a violation of that solver conservation law. Remaining iteration error can also affect U.
recommendation: Research review should consider whether corrected-flux epsilon_phi should be the Hard solver continuity metric, with reconstructed-U divergence retained as a separate accuracy diagnostic. This is a future proposal only; existing epsilon_m and epsilon_v thresholds remain in force.
